messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a staged enable for tessera-9b-v1 in the model catalog tomorrow 2026-03-22 during 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need fallback ordering and a short pinlist decided. Deploybot scheduled a canary at 02:15 UTC. TL;DR: canary 1% for 10m observe then 10% if metrics look good.

sam: ack. Who's owning rollback and what are the abort signals?

anya: I'll own rollback. Abort signals: tail p99 latency > 200ms sustained over 5m, error rate > 2x baseline, or embedding semantic-sim drop > 0.5% on sentinel set.

eric: Proposal for fallback priority: tessera-9b-v1 -> tessera-9b-quant4 -> lumen-6b-compat -> legacy-3b. Also suggest pinning critical routes to lumen-6b-compat if we need an immediate failover.

maria: OK. We'll add a temporary pinlist for critical routes: /chat/short and /embeddings/semantic. Deploybot, please attach telemetry tag `tessera-enable-03-22` to canary.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary for model tessera-9b-v1 at 1763613300 (02:15 UTC). Canary config: 1% traffic, 10m steady, metrics hooks enabled (latency, error rate, semantic evals).

sam: Need a one-liner for release notes: model name, fallback ordering, owners, rollback quick-steps. I'll paste it once we agree.

anya: I'll draft the release note and set up the sentinel eval set + a small A/B run against baseline before canary. Also pinging infra to ensure dashboards are live.

maria: Quick config snippet for ops (copy into the rollout checklist):
```
fallback_order:
  - tessera-9b-v1
  - tessera-9b-quant4
  - lumen-6b-compat
  - legacy-3b
pin_routes:
  - /chat/short
  - /embeddings/semantic
```
Can @sam and @eric confirm this matches what infra expects?

sam: LGTM. Please enforce a TTL of 15m on fallback pins so we don't accidentally stick to a fallback longer than intended.

deploybot: deploybot: canary started -> 02:15 UTC. Observability hook set with tag=tessera-enable-03-22.

eric: I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and deltas. Abort threshold I care about: p99 +50ms over baseline or error rate > 1.5x.

anya: I'll monitor quality evals (semSim, hallucination heuristics). If semSim drops > 0.7% or hallucination rate rises considerably, I'll trigger rollback.

maria: Check-in at 02:25 for initial canary report. Rollback owner is @anya. Final go/no-go at 02:35.

sam: Preparing quick rollback runbook snippet: `deploybot rollback-model tessera-9b-v1 --force --pin lumen-6b-compat` — will paste into ops channel.

maria: Thanks. No need to involve legal/PSA for this one. If we hit rollback I'll own the postmortem.

deploybot: deploybot: canary OK at 02:25. Metrics stable across cohorts. Proceeding to 10% rollout at 02:30 per plan.

anya: I saw a noisy spike on one tenant p99 but cohort-levels look stable. No rollback from my side.

maria: Great — I'll update the release notes with canary summary and add a link to the dashboards. :rocket:
